focus.name: scene-terrain-utilities
focus.purpose: Record three complete utility bodies in the post-render service region without inferring unavailable callers or higher-level roles.

targets.name: Frame_WaitForVBlankAndDelay11
targets.contract: Preserve D0, wait for VBlank, execute eleven NOP iterations, restore D0, and return.

targets.name: SceneResource_ClearScratchWords
targets.contract: Clear 448 words at 0x00FFF17A through a DBF loop.

targets.name: Terrain_WriteMapWordAtOffset
targets.contract: Load a row pointer from 0x00FF9884 using D1, add D0 as a signed word offset, and store D2 at the resulting address.

relationships: 0x001B3406 consumes TERRAIN_ROW_POINTER_TABLE, the same row-pointer table used by Terrain_ResolvePlayerCell.
limitations: The current whole-ROM export reports no direct static callers for these formerly unassigned entries.
The exact semantic subdivision of the 0x00FFF17A scratch region remains unresolved; the target records its fixed address and extent without introducing a broader RAM model.
